content.title: Is Sykkuno's Real Girlfriend Weeniedesu? Inside The Viral Theory Linked To HemomalVT's Claims
content.text: The controversy surrounding Thomas, aka Sykkuno, continues to spiral, with new names coming up every day about the so-called 'wholesome' Twitch star. Now, internet sleuths have brought another name to the center of speculation: Weeniedesu, also known in the streaming community as Madi. Following HemomalVT's explosive allegations in her April 2026 exposé that the 34-year-old streamer had a long-time girlfriend since 2021 while allegedly engaging with multiple women, fans are now revisiting some old clues to figure out who the secret girlfriend could be. But why are many convinced that Madi could be the real girlfriend? Let's find out. Why the internet thinks Weeniedesu is Sykkuno's real girlfriend Before we begin, though, it is important to note that the findings are purely speculative and based on popular theories on Reddit and X, and it is not officially verified whether the individuals mentioned in this article were, or are, romantically involved. Amid fresh speculations rising every day, a screenshot has been circulating online, allegedly taken from Hemomal's exposé document. The image circulating in the OTV community appears to show a Discord conversation with a user named 'madi' (later redacted), who many believe could be fellow streamer Weeniedesu. In the screenshot, the message reads: "“i’m sorry i can’t handle looking at anything else… i need to leave this chat because looking at everything is making me feel sick… if there is something that happens in the future please contact me somewhere… i’m sorry” With that message, the user leaves the chat. Hemomal shared a screenshot in her 32-word Google Doc that exposed Sykkuno. Many users in the online streaming community, especially his fans, claim that the message aligns perfectly with prior references to the influencer's alleged girlfriend in Hemomal's document. Continue reading below Old Reddit theories resurface This isn't actually the first time that Weeniedesu has been linked to Sykkuno. A couple of years ago, a Reddit post had already speculated that the two might be dating, or even possibly living together. The resurfaced post mentioned that Sykkuno and Madi were long speculated to be a thing, given their matching timelines during livestreams, and sleuths even noticed that their streams mentioned similar weather timelines. More importantly, Weeniedesu has previously drawn art designs for Sykkuno, including his fashion line, Ebiko. Fans have long speculated about Sykkuno and Weeniedesu's relationship, connecting the dots over the years. From Madi posting about being upset when Sykkuno went to a strip club to showing up at his livestreams after being away for a long time, many hints sparked the buzz. With Madi starting her livestream shortly after Sykkuno went live, fans wondered if the two were living together. A part of the viral Reddit post reads: "This is not the first time this has been speculated about... She draws his art and designs for him, there’s more to the back story... Also Weeniedesu who hardly ever streams started her stream 10 min after Syk. Weenie says it’s over 100 degrees for her on stream, Syk says it’s 107 degrees the same day. Pic posted is one of the times she immediately jumped into his stream after he yelled. Nothing concrete, just weird coincidences that add up." See the Reddit thread here. With Hemomal's explosive allegations against Sykkuno, especially the fact that she mentioned a live-in girlfriend since 2021, fans are returning to this Reddit thread to share their thoughts. A user wrote, "The moment they expose who his ex is, this post came into my mind right away lol," and another added, "You could have the best 'I told you so' moment right now." A third user mentioned, "OMG u were actually correct. They have been dating since 2021." Who is Weeniedesu (Madi)? Weeniedesu, often referred to as Madi, is a well-known digital illustrator in the streaming and VTuber space, recognized widely for her kawaii-style art. Her Twitch bio states that she has been drawing since 2008-2009 and was last active on the platform three months ago. She joined Twitch in 2017 and began streaming her art and creative content around 2018-2019. While she is not a full-time streamer, she has earned a loyal fan following through her collaborations with major creators like Sykkuno. She also designed the 34-year-old's VTuber model. Weeniedesu likes to lay low when it comes to publicity, but her associations with Sykkuno keep bringing unnecessary spotlight on her. While no one knows her real identity, she has become a respected figure in the online art community, and her extremely private personal life has made her a mysterious figure among fans. With HemomalVT's allegations, the attention has once again shifted to Madi, with the community expressing concerns about her mental health and well-being amid the firestorm. Sykkuno's cheating scandal exposed by HemomalVT On April 14, 2026, HemomalVT, a 20-year-old streamer, released a 32-page document with chat screenshots, receipts, and a voice recording of Sykkuno, exposing his alleged pattern of manipulating up-and-coming female creators with his fake persona. Labelling the creator as a "serial cheater", Hemomal mentioned how Sykkuno (whose real name is Thomas) approached her and fellow VTubers as lonely and claimed that he wanted to form real connections, even offering to move in with some of them. In her document, Hemomal also claimed that Sykkuno maintained a long-term relationship while allegedly forming emotional and romantic connections with multiple women. It was only later that she allegedly came to know about the 34-year-old's long-time girlfriend since 2021, who allegedly lived with him. Many women, former girlfriends, and ex-flings have since shared their own experiences with Sykkuno. As of now, there is no confirmed evidence that Weeniedesu is Sykkuno’s girlfriend.
